title: Welcome to the Blog!
description: This is the very first blog post on the new Astro-powered site.
author: Site Owner
body:
# Welcome to the Blog!

This is the first post in the blog collection. You can write Markdown content here, and it will be automatically picked up by Astro's content collections.

- Astro makes content management easy.
- You can add more posts by creating new markdown files in this folder.

Enjoy blogging!
